title: A framework for conceptualizing agricultural diversification with a focus on the U.S. Corn Belt
abstract: CONTEXT Diversification of agricultural production has been proposed to address interrelated social, ecological, and economic challenges. However, definitions of agricultural diversification vary, and there has been negligible research documenting what farmers consider to be diversification. A shared understanding of agricultural diversification is needed to create common goals and support policies and programs that incorporate the vision of the agriculture community. OBJECTIVE We examine the meaning of agricultural diversification according to agricultural stakeholders with a focus on the U.S. Corn Belt. METHODS Data on farmer understandings of diversification from focus groups ( n = 20 groups) and a survey ( n = 725 respondents) across the U.S. states of Iowa, Illinois, and Indiana are compared to 1) a review of definitions of agricultural diversification found in academic and grey literature and 2) a definition created by a team of academics, Extension, and non-governmental professionals. RESULTS And CONCLUSION Five dimensions of agricultural diversity emerged: biological, economic, human, values, and cognitive. Across sources, diversification is typically discussed in biological and economic terms. Some sources mention values of conservation or sustainability as components of agricultural diversification and relatively fewer identify human dimensions. While the cognitive dimension of diversification did not emerge in the literature review, it was mentioned frequently by focus group participants. SIGNIFICANCE We provide a framework for understanding agricultural diversification and propose future efforts in this area define how the term is used across each of the five dimensions. Future outreach activities can leverage aspects of diversification that are compelling and achievable to farmers.
abstract_zh: 背景 农业生产多样化被认为有助于应对相互关联的社会、生态和经济挑战。然而，农业多样化的定义并不统一，且几乎没有研究记录农民如何理解多样化。需要形成关于农业多样化的共同理解，以便确立共同目标，并支持纳入农业界愿景的政策和计划。目标 本文以美国玉米带为重点，考察农业利益相关方所理解的农业多样化的含义。方法 我们将农民对多样化的理解数据（来自焦点小组，n = 20组，以及调查，n = 725名受访者，覆盖爱荷华州、伊利诺伊州和印第安纳州）与以下两方面进行比较：1）学术文献和灰色文献中出现的农业多样化定义的综述；2）由学者、推广机构和非政府专业人员组成的团队所制定的定义。结果与结论 农业多样性的五个维度浮现出来：生物、经济、人力、价值观和认知。在各类文献中，多样化通常以生物和经济的角度讨论。部分文献提到保护或可持续性等价值观是农业多样化的组成部分，而涉及人力维度的文献相对较少。虽然认知维度在文献综述中并未出现，但焦点小组参与者却频繁提及。意义 我们提供了一个理解农业多样化的框架，并建议未来的工作在这一领域对五个维度中该术语的使用方式加以界定。未来的推广活动可以利用多样化中那些对农民具有吸引力且切实可行的方面。

title: Additionality of Afforestation Incentives: Evidence from the Conservation Reserve Program
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Econometric evaluation of the impact of agricultural conservation on nonpoint source pollution: An application to the Wabash River watershed
abstract: Agricultural production is the largest contributor of nitrogen and phosphorus pollution in lakes, rivers, and streams in the United States. The effectiveness of agricultural conservation programs that encourage farmers to adopt certain practices to reduce this water pollution, once implemented, is an open question. We develop a unique data set combining the spatial structure of the watershed river system, the timing of federal conservation contracts, water quality measurements, land use, land cover, and weather data to study the effect of conservation contracts on nitrogen and phosphorus levels in the Wabash River watershed, which drains Indiana and Illinois. We develop econometric models that generate a causal understanding of the effectiveness of these conservation contracts for reducing nitrogen and phosphorus levels in the surface water system. We find that at current treatment levels, these programs reduce surface water pollution only during relatively dry periods. The efficacy of these programs in the study area is highly sensitive to precipitation to the extent that average precipitation can eliminate the nutrient loss reduction benefits of conservation program installations at current treatment levels. Therefore, we find weak evidence to support ambient downstream water quality improvements resulting from program investment levels to date. We anticipate this work will motivate further inquiry into the manner in which these conservation programs have or have not been effective.
abstract_zh: 农业生产是美国湖泊、河流和溪流中氮和磷污染的最大来源。鼓励农民采用特定做法以减少这类水污染的农业保护计划，在实施后的效果仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们构建了一个独特的数据集，将流域河网的空间结构、联邦保护合同的签订时间、水质测量、土地利用、土地覆盖和气象数据结合起来，以研究保护合同对流经印第安纳州和伊利诺伊州的沃巴什河流域氮、磷水平的影响。我们建立了计量经济模型，以对这些保护合同在降低地表水氮、磷水平方面的有效性形成因果性认识。我们发现，在当前的处理水平下，这些计划仅在相对干旱时期才能减少地表水污染。研究区域内这些计划的效果对降水高度敏感，以至于平均降水量就可以抵消当前处理水平下保护计划安装所带来的养分流失减少效益。因此，我们发现几乎没有可靠证据支持迄今为止的计划投入水平能够改善下游水体的环境质量。我们预计，这项工作将推动进一步探讨这些保护计划过去是否有效、以及为何有效或无效的问题。

title: Interplay between Voluntary Private Carbon Initiatives and USDA Programs
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: A growing number of voluntary private carbon initiatives (VPCIs) offer monetary incentives to agricultural producers to adopt conservation practices that have potential to mitigate climate change. Farmers can also enroll in USDA conservation programs for working lands to receive cost-share payments and technical assistance to increase area under conservation practices. This study describes and compares VPCIs and existing federal conservation programs for working croplands and provides potential ways to improve their synergies in promoting the implementation of climate-smart practices.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的自愿性私人碳倡议（Voluntary Private Carbon Initiatives，VPCIs）向农业生产者提供经济激励，鼓励其采用有助于减缓气候变化的保护性做法。农民也可以参加美国农业部面向耕作土地的保护计划，以获得成本分摊补贴和技术援助，从而扩大采用保护性做法的面积。本研究描述并比较了VPCIs与现行面向耕作农田的联邦保护计划，并提出了改善两者协同作用、促进气候智慧型做法落实的可能途径。

title: Pay the Polluter or Polluter Pays? A Preliminary Assessment of Public Preferences for Water Quality Policy
To Diversify or Not to Diversify: A Preliminary Report on Farmers’ Perspectives on Diversification in the U.S. Midwest
abstract: Diversifying the simplified landscape of corn and soybeans in the Midwest is an emerging priority in both the public and private sectors to reap a suite of climate, social, agronomic, and economic benefits. However, little research has documented the perspectives of farmers, the primary stakeholders in diversification efforts. This preliminary report uses newly collected survey data (n = 725) from farmers in the states of Illinois, Indiana, and Iowa to provide descriptive statistics and tests to understand what farmers in the region think about agricultural diversification, including their perspectives on its benefits, barriers, and opportunities. For the purposes of the study, we define diversification as extended rotations, perennials, horticulture, grazed livestock, and agroforestry practices. We find that a majority or plurality of farmers in the sample believe that diversified systems are superior to non-diversified systems at achieving a range of environmental, agronomic, and economic goals, although many farmers are still forming opinions. Farmers believe that primarily economic barriers stand in the way of diversification, including the lack of affordable land, low short-term returns on investment, and lack of labor. Farmers identified key opportunities to increase diversification through developing processing capacity for local meat and specialty crops, increasing demand for diversified products, and providing more information on returns on investment of diversified systems. Different interventions, however, may be needed to support farmers who are already diversified compared to non-diversified farmers. Building on these initial results, future studies using these data will develop more detailed analyses and recommendations for policymakers, the private sector, and agricultural organizations to support diversification.
abstract_zh: 美国中西部地区玉米和大豆单一化的种植格局，正在成为公共部门和私营部门共同关注的新优先事项，多样化种植有望带来气候、社会、农艺和经济等多方面的益处。然而，很少有研究记录农民的观点，而农民正是多样化努力中的主要利益相关方。本初步报告利用新近收集的农民调查数据（n = 725），来自伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州和爱荷华州，提供描述性统计和检验，以了解该地区农民对农业多样化的看法，包括他们对其益处、障碍和机遇的观点。为本研究之目的，我们将多样化定义为延长轮作、多年生作物、园艺、放牧畜牧业和农林复合做法。我们发现，样本中多数或相对多数的农民认为，多样化系统在实现一系列环境、农艺和经济目标方面优于非多样化系统，尽管许多农民仍在形成看法。农民认为，主要是经济障碍阻碍了多样化，包括缺乏价格可承受的土地、短期投资回报低以及劳动力短缺。农民指出，若要增加多样化，关键机遇在于发展本地肉类和特色作物的加工能力、增加对多样化产品的需求，以及提供更多关于多样化系统投资回报的信息。不过，对于已经实行多样化的农民与未实行多样化的农民，可能需要不同的干预措施加以支持。在这些初步结果的基础上，利用这些数据开展的后续研究将进行更详细的分析，并为政策制定者、私营部门和农业组织提出建议，以支持多样化发展。

title: Estimating the Impact of Cover Crop Adoption on Ambient Nitrogen Concentration in the Upper Mississippi River Drainage
abstract: We examine cover crop (CC) adoption to determine how this soil health practice has influenced agricultural non‐point source pollution. We use remotely sensed data on practice adoption, and control for hydrological flow direction, weather, and land use to estimate the ex post impact of CC on total Nitrogen concentrations in surface water while controlling for pollutant spillovers from upstream. At the mean treatment level in the study area (3.2%), a 1% increase in CC adoption results in a 0.06 mg/L (2%) reduction in concentration in the study area. Results provide novel estimates based on observed data that can be compared to biophysical simulations of CC effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 我们考察覆盖作物（Cover Crop，CC）的采用情况，以确定这一土壤健康做法如何影响农业非点源污染。我们利用遥感数据获取做法采用情况，并控制水文流向、天气和土地利用等因素，以估计覆盖作物对地表水中总氮浓度的事后影响，同时控制来自上游的污染物溢出效应。在研究区域的平均处理水平（3.2%）下，覆盖作物采用率每增加1%，研究区域的浓度降低0.06 mg/L（2%）。这些结果基于观测数据提供了新的估计值，可与覆盖作物效果的生物物理模拟结果进行比较。

title: How could payments for U.S. climate-smart farming practices change the regional adoption of conservation practices?
abstract: Recent U.S. policies have promoted climate-smart farming practices. However, little is known about the costs of practice adoption or the regional allocation of support. The primary objective of this study is to identify cost-effective agricultural practices for climate mitigation and determine where practices might be targeted regionally. This study uses average regional abatement cost curves for six mitigation practices to analyze how conservation funding could incentivize adoption. Using a social benefit threshold of $51 per metric ton, we estimate that for all practices studied, except cover crops, there are regions where the average cost of reduction is less than the social benefit threshold, meaning that greenhouse gas could be cost-effectively mitigated or sequestered at regional levels given more adoption of these practices. For the purposes of conservation targeting, we outline the regions where the adoption of these practices is potentially the most cost-effective.
abstract_zh: 近期美国政策推动了气候智慧型农业做法。然而，人们对做法采用的成本以及支持资金的区域分配情况知之甚少。本研究的主要目标是识别具有成本效益的农业气候减缓做法，并确定这些做法在区域层面应重点推广的地区。本研究利用六种减排做法的平均区域减排成本曲线，分析保护资金如何激励这些做法的采用。以每公吨51美元的社会收益阈值计算，我们估计，除覆盖作物外，所研究的所有做法都存在某些地区的平均减排成本低于该社会收益阈值，这意味着若进一步推广这些做法，温室气体可以在区域层面以具有成本效益的方式得到减排或固存。出于保护目标定位的考虑，我们勾勒出这些做法的采用可能最具成本效益的地区。

title: Integrated agricultural practices and engineering technologies enhance synergies of food-energy-water systems in Corn Belt Watersheds
abstract: Interconnected food, energy, water systems (FEWS) require systems level understanding to design efficient and effective management strategies and policies that address potentially competing challenges of production and environmental quality. Adoption of agricultural best management practices (BMPs) can reduce nonpoint source phosphorus (P) loads, but there are also opportunities to recover P from point sources, which could also reduce demand for mineral P fertilizer derived from declining geologic reserves. Here, we apply the Integrated Technology-Environment-Economics Model to investigate the consequences of watershed-scale portfolios of agricultural BMPs and environmental and biological technologies (EBTs) for co-benefits of FEWS in Corn Belt watersheds. Via a pilot study with a representative agro-industrial watershed with high P and nitrogen discharge, we show achieving the nutrient reduction goals in the watershed; BMP-only portfolios require extensive and costly land-use change (19% of agricultural land) to perennial energy grasses, while portfolios combining BMPs and EBTs can improve water quality while recovering P from corn biorefineries and wastewater streams with only 4% agricultural land-use change. The potential amount of P recovered from EBTs is estimated as 2 times as much as the agronomic P requirement in the watershed, showing the promise of the P circular economy. These findings inform solution development based on the combination of agricultural BMPs and EBTs for the cobenefits of FEWS in Corn Belt watersheds.
abstract_zh: 相互关联的食物、能源和水系统（Food, Energy, Water Systems，FEWS）需要从系统层面加以理解，才能设计出高效、有效的管理策略和政策，以应对生产与环境质量之间可能相互冲突的挑战。采用农业最佳管理实践（Best Management Practices，BMPs）可以减少非点源磷（P）负荷，但从点源回收磷的机会同样存在，这也可以减少对日益枯竭的地质储量所生产的矿物磷肥的需求。在此，我们应用综合技术—环境—经济模型（Integrated Technology-Environment-Economics Model），研究在玉米带流域尺度上，农业最佳管理实践与环境及生物技术（Environmental and Biological Technologies，EBTs）的组合方案对FEWS协同效益的影响。通过对一个磷和氮排放量较高的代表性农工业流域开展的试点研究，我们发现：要实现该流域的养分减排目标，仅采用最佳管理实践的方案需要进行大规模且成本高昂的土地利用变化（占农业用地的19%），将其转为多年生能源草；而将最佳管理实践与环境及生物技术相结合的方案，既能改善水质，又能从玉米生物精炼厂和废水流中回收磷，且仅需4%的农业用地发生变化。据估计，通过环境及生物技术可回收的磷量为该流域农艺需磷量的2倍，显示了磷循环经济的前景。这些发现为基于农业最佳管理实践与环境及生物技术组合的解决方案开发提供了依据，以实现玉米带流域FEWS的协同效益。

title: Valuing Ecosystem Services and Downstream Water Quality Improvement in the U.S. Corn Belt
A meta-analysis of agricultural conservation intentions, behaviors, and practices: Insights from 35 years of quantitative literature in the United States
abstract: Conservation practices (CPs) are integral to maintaining the long-term viability of agro-ecological systems. Because farming systems and farmers' values and attitudes are heterogeneous, factors that consistently predict conservation behaviors remain elusive. Moreover, heterogeneity is present among studies regarding the type of CPs examined, and whether behavioral intentions or actual behaviors were measured. This study considers the characteristics of each CP, and whether a given study measured behavioral intention or actual behavior, to better understand farmers' adoption of CPs. We reviewed and analyzed 35 years (1982-2017) of quantitative conservation adoption literature in the United States. We categorized CPs based on their primary purpose, the type of benefit they provide, and whether they are operational or structural. We also examined the following five CPs: conservation tillage, buffers or borders, soil testing, grassed waterways, and cover crops. In our behavioral intention and actual behavior analysis, we found that attitudinal factors predicted both conservation intention and action (actual behavior), whereas current or previous use of practices only influenced actions, not stated conservation intentions. In our analysis focusing on CP characteristics, we found that having specific knowledge about and positive attitudes toward the CP, adoption of other CPs, seeking and using information, larger farm size, and vulnerable land predicted actual adoption across nearly all CP categorizations. Nuances emerge when comparing predictors of CPs that share a particular characteristic. For example, we found farm characteristics to be comparatively more important in predicting adoption of soil management CPs than nutrient and livestock management CPs, and farmers' stewardship identity to be more important for permanent practices than operational practices.
abstract_zh: 保护性做法（Conservation Practices，CPs）对维持农业生态系统的长期可持续性至关重要。由于农业系统以及农民的价值观和态度存在异质性，能够持续预测保护行为的因素至今仍难以确定。此外，各研究在所考察的保护性做法类型，以及测量的是行为意愿还是实际行为方面也存在差异。本研究考虑了每种保护性做法的特征，以及某项研究测量的是行为意愿还是实际行为，以更好地理解农民采用保护性做法的情况。我们回顾并分析了美国35年（1982—2017年）的定量保护性做法采用文献。我们根据保护性做法的主要目的、其所提供的收益类型，以及其属于操作型还是结构型，对这些做法进行了分类。我们还考察了以下五种保护性做法：保护性耕作、缓冲带或边界、土壤测试、草皮水道和覆盖作物。在行为意愿与实际行为的分析中，我们发现态度因素既能预测保护意愿，也能预测实际行动，而当前或既往的做法使用情况只影响实际行动，并不影响所陈述的保护意愿。在关于保护性做法特征的分析中，我们发现，对保护性做法具有专门知识并持积极态度、采用其他保护性做法、寻求和利用信息、农场规模较大以及土地脆弱性，在几乎所有保护性做法分类中都能预测实际采用情况。在比较具有某一特定特征的保护性做法的预测因素时，还出现了一些细微差别。例如，我们发现，与养分和畜牧管理类保护性做法相比，农场特征对土壤管理类保护性做法的采用预测作用相对更重要；而对于永久性做法，农民的管护者身份认同比对于操作性做法更为重要。

title: Agri-Environmental Programs in the United States and Canada
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Canada and the United States have a rich history of policy interventions aimed at improving environmental outcomes from agricultural production. We review the agri-environmental programs in these two countries as well as the related economic literature. Despite the impacts of agriculture on land, water, and climate quality, the literature on agri-environmental programs has largely focused on a few major programs or the adoption of specific management practices. Far less research evaluates programs on active farmland, environmental regulation of agriculture, and the interactions of these policies and programs. Further research is also needed on how the heterogeneity of environmental characteristics and processes affects the outcomes of management practices and how these outcomes might be affected by climate change. Given the continued substantial impacts of agriculture on environmental outcomes, the increased interest of agricultural processors and consumers in these outcomes, and the potential for new models and data to inform research, we conclude that this is an ideal time to examine and apply lessons learned from past program successes and failures as we seek to improve the performance of the next generation of agri-environmental policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 加拿大和美国在旨在改善农业生产环境结果的政策干预方面有着悠久的历史。我们回顾了这两个国家的农业环境计划以及相关的经济学文献。尽管农业对土地、水质和气候质量均有影响，但关于农业环境计划的文献主要集中在少数几个主要计划或特定管理做法的采用上。针对仍在耕种农田上实施的计划、农业环境监管，以及这些政策和计划之间的相互作用，相关研究要少得多。关于环境特征与过程的异质性如何影响管理做法的结果，以及这些结果可能如何受到气候变化影响，也需要进一步研究。鉴于农业对环境结果的持续重大影响，农产品加工商和消费者对这些结果的兴趣日益增加，以及新模型和新数据为研究提供信息的潜力，我们认为，现在正是总结和应用过去计划成败经验的理想时机，以期提升下一代农业环境政策干预的绩效。

title: Understanding the relationship between land tenure and conservation behavior: Recommendations for social science research
Conservation Tillage Mitigates Drought Induced Soybean Yield Losses in the US Corn Belt
abstract: Conservation tillage has been widely recommended for implementation in the U.S. for its environmental benefits. The effect of conservation tillage on crop yield is a subject of continued concern amongst farmers who have not adopted the practice. Previous empirical research on the yield performance of conservation tillage is largely limited to field trials, while observational studies remain scant. This article estimates the effects of conservation tillage on county average corn and soybean yields using remotely-sensed tillage practice adoption data in 646 counties across 12 Corn Belt states from 2005 to 2018. Exploiting deviations from county-specific means in the data, we find no evidence that conservation tillage negatively affects corn or soybean yields. We also find that it can mitigate the impact of drought on soybean yields. We explore how wider use of conservation tillage might offset the increase in drought-induced downside risk to soybean yields under climate change projections from five global climate models.
abstract_zh: 保护性耕作因其环境效益而在美国被广泛推荐。然而，其对作物产量的影响，一直是尚未采用该做法的农民所关注的问题。以往关于保护性耕作产量表现的实证研究大多局限于田间试验，而观测性研究仍然稀少。本文利用遥感获得的耕作做法采用数据，估计了2005至2018年间，覆盖玉米带12个州646个县的保护性耕作对县平均玉米和大豆产量的影响。通过利用数据中相对于各县均值的偏离，我们未发现保护性耕作对玉米或大豆产量产生负面影响的证据。我们还发现，保护性耕作可以减轻干旱对大豆产量的影响。我们探讨了在气候变化预测下，五个全球气候模式所显示的干旱导致的大豆减产下行风险增加，若更广泛地使用保护性耕作，能在多大程度上抵消这一风险。

title: Cost-Competitiveness and Carbon Footprint of Dedicated Energy Crops for Cellulosic Biofuels: Insights from a Spatial Multi-feedstock Procurement Landscape Analysis
Developing an Integrated Technology- Environment-Economics Model to Simulate Food-Energy-Water Systems in Corn Belt Watersheds
Agricultural Impacts of Climate Change in Indiana and Potential Adaptations
Market Structure and the Effect of Ethanol Expansion on Land Allocation: A Spatially Explicit Analysis

Adoption of Agricultural Conservation Practices in the United States: Evidence from 35 Years of Quantitative Literature
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: This is a comprehensive review of all published, quantitative studies focused on adoption of agricultural conservation practices in the United States between 1982 and 2017. This review finds that, taken as a whole, few independent variables have a consistent statistically significant relationship with adoption. Analyses showed that variables positively associated with adoption include the farmer self-identifying primarily as stewardship motivated or otherwise nonfinancially motivated, environmental attitudes, a positive attitude toward the particular program or practice, previous adoption of other conservation practices, seeking and using information, awareness of programs or practices, vulnerable land, greater farm size, higher levels of income and formal education, engaging in marketing arrangements, and positive yield impact expected. Some variables often thought to be important, such as land tenure, did not emerge as consistently important in this cross-study review. Other variables, such as farmers9 sense of place, training, presence of institutional conditions supporting adoption, and the role of collective decision making are not measured in enough studies to draw conclusions but potentially have a relationship with adoption decisions. Implications for how to promote conservation adoption and directions for future research are discussed. Because positive attitudes and awareness of conservation programs or practices are positive predictors of adoption, practitioners should share benefits of specific practices and programs and leverage existing practice adoption. Further work to explore relationships between conservation adoption and the role of farmer identity, nuances of land tenure, and the influence of structural factors is needed. Moreover, we suggest that future research should focus on the impact of different messages and avenues of reaching farmers in order to continue to inform conservation practices. Future research should consider both individual and institutional factors that facilitate and constrain adoption.
abstract_zh: 本文是对1982年至2017年间美国农业保护性做法采用问题的所有已发表定量研究所作的全面综述。综述发现，总体而言，很少有自变量与采用行为之间存在一致的、统计上显著的关系。分析表明，与采用正相关的变量包括：农民主要以管护者身份或其他非经济动机进行自我认同、环境态度、对特定计划或做法持积极态度、既往采用其他保护性做法、寻求和利用信息、了解计划或做法、土地脆弱性、较大的农场规模、较高的收入和正规教育水平、参与营销安排，以及预期的正向产量影响。一些通常被认为重要的变量，如土地权属，并未在这项跨研究综述中表现出一致的重要性。另一些变量，如农民的地方感、培训、支持采用的制度条件，以及集体决策的作用，由于测量它们的研究数量不足，尚不足以得出结论，但它们可能与采用决策存在关联。文中讨论了促进保护性做法采用的政策含义以及未来研究的方向。由于积极态度以及对保护计划或做法的认知是采用的正向预测因素，从业者应宣传特定做法和计划的益处，并利用现有的做法采用基础。需要进一步探讨保护性做法采用与农民身份认同的作用、土地权属的细微差别，以及结构性因素的影响。此外，我们建议未来研究应关注不同信息和不同渠道对接触农民的影响，以持续为保护性做法提供参考。未来研究应同时考虑促进或制约采用的个体因素与制度因素。

title: Agro-Climatic Data by County: A Spatially and Temporally Consistent U.S. Dataset for Agricultural Yields, Weather and Soils
abstract: Agro-climatic data by county (ACDC) is designed to provide the major agro-climatic variables from publicly available spatial data sources to diverse end-users. ACDC provides USDA NASS annual (1981–2015) crop yields for corn, soybeans, upland cotton and winter wheat by county. Customizable growing degree days for 1 °C intervals between −60 °C and +60 °C, and total precipitation for two different crop growing seasons from the PRISM weather data are included. Soil characteristic data from USDA-NRCS gSSURGO are also provided for each county in the 48 contiguous US states. All weather and soil data are processed to include only data for land being used for non-forestry agricultural uses based on the USGS NLCD land cover/land use data. This paper explains the numerical and geo-computational methods and data generating processes employed to create ACDC from the original data sources. Essential considerations for data management and use are discussed, including the use of the agricultural mask, spatial aggregation and disaggregation, and the computational requirements for working with the raw data sources.
abstract_zh: 县级农业气候数据（Agro-climatic data by county，ACDC）旨在从公开可用的空间数据源中提取主要农业气候变量，供各类终端用户使用。ACDC提供了美国农业部国家农业统计局（USDA NASS）在县级层面的玉米、大豆、陆地棉和冬小麦年度产量（1981—2015年）。它还包括可定制的生长度日（growing degree days），以1摄氏度为间隔，范围从零下60摄氏度至正60摄氏度，以及来自PRISM天气数据的、两个不同作物生长季的总降水量。此外，ACDC还提供了美国农业部自然资源保护服务局（USDA-NRCS）gSSURGO的土壤特征数据，覆盖美国本土48个州的每个县。所有气象和土壤数据均依据美国地质调查局NLCD土地覆盖/土地利用数据进行处理，仅保留用于非林业农业用途的土地数据。本文阐述了将原始数据源加工为ACDC所采用的数值方法、地理计算方法以及数据生成过程。文中还讨论了数据管理和使用中的重要注意事项，包括农业掩膜的使用、空间聚合与分解，以及处理原始数据源所需的计算要求。

title: Harnessing the Potential of Emerging Technologies to Mitigate the Hypoxia Challenge
The effect of projected climate change on the economics of conservation tillage
abstract:
We evaluate the economics of conservation tillage (chisel till and no till) and examine the impact of projected climate change on the economic attractiveness of reduced tillage practices. We use data from a long‐term (39‐yr) field experiment in Indiana to estimate yield response functions describing the relationship between tillage practices and corn (Zea mays L.) and soybean (Glycine max L.) yields in poorly drained (but systematically tile‐drained) soils, and the mediating role of weather and crop rotation on that relationship. We subsequently couple estimated yield functions with stochastic simulations of weather variables under current and projected climatic regimes to construct distributions describing the probability that conservation tillage will result in higher profits than more intensive tillage under alternative crop rotations. We calculate the subsidy, if needed, that would make a risk‐neutral farmer indifferent between conservation and intensive tillage practices under alternative climatic regimes. A key finding of this study is that projected climate change enhances the economics of conservation tillage, thereby substantially reducing the economic hurdle required to induce its adoption in the study area. The framework developed and demonstrated can be applied to areas with different soils and growing conditions to examine the economics of conservation tillage under current and future climate.
Core Ideas
We examine effect of climate change on economics of reduced tillage.
We use data from a long‐term field experiment in Indiana
We calculate probability that reduced till will result in higher profit
Projected climate change enhances the economics of conservation tillage
Climate change may substantially reduce subsidies required for adoption
abstract_zh:
我们评估了保护性耕作（包括凿式耕作和免耕）的经济性，并考察预测的气候变化对减少耕作做法经济吸引力的影响。我们利用印第安纳州一项长期（39年）田间试验的数据，估计耕作做法与玉米（Zea mays L.）和大豆（Glycine max L.）产量之间的产量响应函数，这些土壤排水不良（但经过系统性暗管排水）；同时估计天气和作物轮作在这一关系中的中介作用。随后，我们将估计的产量函数与当前及预测气候条件下天气变量的随机模拟相结合，构建分布，用以描述在不同轮作制度下，保护性耕作带来高于强度耕作利润的概率。若需要补贴，我们计算了能使风险中性农民在不同气候条件下对保护性耕作和强度耕作无差异的补贴水平。本研究的一个关键发现是，预测的气候变化增强了保护性耕作的经济性，从而大幅降低了在研究区域促使其采用所需的经济门槛。所建立和演示的框架可应用于具有不同土壤和生长条件的地区，以考察当前和未来气候下保护性耕作的经济性。
核心观点
我们考察了气候变化对减少耕作经济性的影响。
我们使用了印第安纳州一项长期田间试验的数据。
我们计算了减少耕作带来更高利润的概率。
预测的气候变化增强了保护性耕作的经济性。
气候变化可能大幅降低促使采用所需的补贴。

title: Toward a regional phosphorus (re)cycle in the U.S. Midwest
A Risk Analysis of Precision Agriculture Technology to Manage Tomato Late Blight
abstract: Precision agriculture technology can transform farming related data into useful information, which may lead to more efficient usage of agricultural resources and increase sustainability. This paper compares precision agriculture technology with traditional practices in scheduling fungicide application so as to manage late blight disease in tomato production. The following three fungicide scheduling strategies were evaluated: a calendar-based strategy, the BlightPro Decision Support System based strategy (DSS-based strategy), and a strategy that does not involve fungicide application. The data from field trials and computer simulation experiments were used to construct distributions of the net return per acre for the calendar-based and the DSS-based strategies. These distributions were then compared using three standard approaches to ranking risky alternatives, namely: stochastic dominance, stochastic dominance with respect to a function, and stochastic efficiency with respect to a function. Assuming no yield differences between the calendar-based and the DSS-based strategies, the calendar-based strategy was preferred for highly late blight susceptible cultivars, and the DSS-based strategy was preferred for moderately susceptible and moderately resistant cultivars. Assuming no yield differences, the value of the BlightPro Decision Support System ranged from −$28 to $48 per acre. With the yield improvement for the DSS-based strategy included, the DSS-based strategy was preferred for the cultivars in all of the disease-resistance categories with the value ranging from $496 to $1714 per acre.
abstract_zh: 精准农业技术能够将农业生产相关数据转化为有用的信息，从而可能提高农业资源的利用效率并增强可持续性。本文比较了精准农业技术与传统做法在番茄晚疫病防治中杀菌剂施用时间安排上的差异。我们评估了三种杀菌剂施用策略：基于日历的策略、基于BlightPro决策支持系统（DSS）的策略，以及不施用杀菌剂的策略。我们利用田间试验数据和计算机模拟实验，构建了基于日历策略和基于DSS策略每英亩净收益的分布。随后，我们采用三种风险备选方案排序的标准方法对这些分布进行比较，即：随机占优、关于某一函数的随机占优，以及关于某一函数的随机效率。在假定两种策略产量无差异的前提下，对于高度感染晚疫病的品种，基于日历的策略更受青睐；对于中度感病和中度抗病的品种，基于DSS的策略更受青睐。假定产量无差异时，BlightPro决策支持系统的价值范围为每英亩负28美元至正48美元。若将基于DSS策略的产量提升计入在内，则在所有抗病类别的品种中，基于DSS的策略均更受青睐，其价值范围为每英亩496美元至1714美元。

title: Farmer Preferences for Agricultural Soil Carbon Sequestration Schemes
Presentation Matters: Number of Attributes Presented Impacts Estimated Preferences
Climate change beliefs, risk perceptions, and adaptation behavior among Midwestern U.S. crop farmers
abstract: Global climate change presents unique challenges to the resilience of United States agriculture, and farmers and advisors must utilize effective adaptation strategies to be both economically and environmentally sustainable. This study addresses Midwestern U.S. crop farmers’ beliefs about climate change, perceived risks from weather and climate, and attitudes toward adaptation that influence their decisions to adopt adaptation strategies. Analyzing a 2012 survey of nearly 5000 corn farmers across 22 Midwestern U.S. Watersheds, we investigate the most common weather and climate risk management strategies, including purchasing additional crop insurance, implementing conservation practices, and adding new technology. U.S. farmers’ belief in anthropogenic climate change, perceptions of changing weather patterns, climate risks to their farm and attitudes toward adapting are analyzed. Farmers’ perceptions of risk to their own farm, attitudes toward innovation and adaptation attitudes were the most important determinants of adaptation. This study highlights the critical role of risk perceptions in adaptation attitudes as well as behaviors among agriculturalists. Finally, we discuss how these findings could be applied to increase uptake of adaptation strategies and thus resilience of U.S. agriculture to a changing climate.
abstract_zh: 全球气候变化对美国农业的韧性提出了独特挑战，农民和顾问必须采用有效的适应策略，才能在经济和环境两方面实现可持续发展。本研究探讨美国中西部作物农民对气候变化的信念、对天气与气候风险的感知，以及影响其采用适应策略决策的适应态度。我们分析了2012年对22个美国中西部流域近5000名玉米农民开展的调查，考察了最常见的天气与气候风险管理策略，包括购买额外的作物保险、实施保护性做法以及采用新技术。本文分析了美国农民对人为气候变化的信念、对天气模式变化的感知、其农场面临的气候风险，以及对适应的态度。农民对自身农场风险的感知、对创新和适应的态度，是决定适应行为最重要的因素。本研究强调了风险感知在农业从业者适应态度与行为中的关键作用。最后，我们讨论了如何应用这些发现，以提高适应策略的采用率，从而增强美国农业应对气候变化的韧性。

title: Finding the Right Value: Framing Effects on Domain Experts
Integrated economic and environmental assessment of cellulosic biofuel production in an agricultural watershed
Nitrogen Application Decision-making under Climate Risk in the U.S. Corn Belt
abstract: Nitrogen fertilizer is one of the most important inputs to corn production and farmers manage their crop by deciding how much to apply, when to apply it and how to apply it to maximize their yields and resulting profit. There is risk inherent in crop fertility management because once nitrogen is applied to the soil it is no longer immobile and cropland is subject to loss of this costly input under different weather conditions. Days suitable for field work , a farm’s machinery set, and weather conditions determine when field preparation and planting activities are completed each year. This paper documents the methods and data used to evaluate the economic costs and benefits of the agronomic practice of “splitting” nitrogen fertilizer—applying some at or just before planting and a second application after the plant has already emerged and is in greatest need of nutrients. An example of how to use the free online decision support tool Corn Split N DST (splitn.agclimate4u.org) to evaluate the climate risk and economics of post-planting N applications is developed to illustrate the application of methods described.
abstract_zh: 氮肥是玉米生产中最重要的投入品之一，农民通过决定施用多少、何时施用以及如何施用来管理作物，以最大化产量和由此产生的利润。作物肥力管理本身存在风险，因为氮素一旦施入土壤便不再固定不动，耕地会因不同天气条件而损失这一成本高昂的投入品。适宜田间作业的天数、农场的机械配置以及天气状况，决定了每年田间整地和播种活动何时完成。本文记录了用于评估农艺做法“分次施氮”（即在播种时或播种前施用一部分氮肥，并在作物出苗、最需要养分时进行第二次施用）经济成本与收益的方法和数据。我们以免费在线决策支持工具 Corn Split N DST（splitn.agclimate4u.org）为例，说明如何评估播后追施氮肥的气候风险与经济性，并以此展示所述方法的应用。

title: A multiple metrics approach to prioritizing strategies for measuring and managing reactive nitrogen in the San Joaquin Valley of California
Using a team survey to improve team communication for enhanced delivery of agro-climate decision support tools
Climate Forecasts for Corn Producer Decision-Making
abstract: Corn is the most widely grown crop in the Americas, with annual production in the United States of approximately 332 million metric tons. Improved climate forecasts, together with climate-related decision tools for corn producers based on these improved forecasts, could substantially reduce uncertainty and increase profitability for corn producers. The purpose of this paper is to acquaint climate information developers, climate information users, and climate researchers with an overview of weather conditions throughout the year that affect corn production as well as forecast content and timing needed by producers. The authors provide a graphic depicting the climate-informed decision cycle, which they call the climate forecast–decision cycle calendar for corn.
abstract_zh: 玉米是美洲种植最广的作物，美国的年产量约为3.32亿公吨。改进的气候预报，加上基于这些改进预报、面向玉米生产者的气候相关决策工具，可以大幅降低不确定性并提高玉米生产者的盈利能力。本文旨在向气候信息开发者、气候信息用户和气候研究人员概述全年影响玉米生产的天气条件，以及生产者所需的预报内容和时机。作者提供了一张描绘气候信息驱动决策周期的示意图，并将其称为玉米的“气候预报—决策周期日历”。

title: Environmental and economic tradeoffs in a watershed when using corn stover for bioenergy
Farmer Beliefs about Climate Change and Mechanisms to Incentivize Soil Carbon Storage
Farmers and conservation programs: Explaining differences in Environmental Quality Incentives Program applications between states
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Despite its economic and social benefits, agriculture is now a leading source of water pollution in the United States. While significant research effort has attempted to understand adoption of conservation practices on agricultural lands, relatively little research has explored the operation of specific agri-environmental policies in the United States. This research attempts to gain an understanding of how differing agricultural and sociopolitical contexts across the United States influence attempted participation in national agricultural conservation programs. Application rates in the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) differ across the 50 states, indicating potentially important differences in state setting that influence behavior of individual farm operators. A variety of agricultural and sociopolitical measures were included in a fractional logit model to assess factors contributing to varying rates of application to EQIP. Significant explanatory variables included high sales farm prevalence, tenancy rates, and views on federal environmental spending. There also appears to be a large regional effect, with states in the Southeast, Mountain West, and Northeast having higher application rates than those in the Corn Belt. The results of this analysis indicate that certain types of farmers are more likely to seek participation in this large agricultural conservation program. Further research is needed to assess the role of government agencies (federal, state, and local) in influencing participation rates and what role individual political opinion may play in decisions related to federal cost share programs.
abstract_zh: 尽管农业具有经济和社会效益，但它现已成为美国水污染的主要来源。虽然已有大量研究试图理解农业用地上保护性做法的采用情况，但对于美国特定农业环境政策的实际运作，相关研究却相对较少。本研究试图理解美国各地不同的农业与社会政治背景如何影响国家农业保护计划的参与意愿。环境质量激励计划（Environmental Quality Incentives Program，EQIP）的申请率在50个州之间存在差异，这表明州层面的背景差异可能影响农场经营者的个体行为。我们在分数logit模型中纳入了多种农业和社会政治指标，以评估导致EQIP申请率差异的因素。显著的解释变量包括高销售额农场的比例、租佃率，以及对联邦环境支出的看法。区域效应也很明显：东南部、落基山脉西部和东北部各州的申请率高于玉米带各州。分析结果表明，某些类型的农民更有可能寻求参与这一大型农业保护计划。未来需要进一步研究政府机构（联邦、州和地方）在影响参与率方面的作用，以及个人政治观点在与联邦成本分摊计划相关的决策中可能扮演的角色。

title: Why Do Farmers Adopt Conservation Tillage? An Experimental Investigation of Framing Effects
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: In this paper, framing effects are investigated in a new context: farmer decision making about conservation tillage practices. Primary hypotheses include the following: (1) frames (i.e., different arguments about or conceptions of an issue) portraying conservation tillage as “profitable” will generate more interest in the tillage technique among farmers than a control frame presenting only basic information; (2) frames discussing potential payments for “environmental benefits” will generate more positive attitudes than frames discussing payment for “storing carbon (C)” to limit climate change; and (3) framing effects will vary based on subjects9 prior beliefs and experiences. These hypotheses were tested using a survey-based experiment administered to a national sample of row-crop farmers. Contrary to expectations, the profit frame and both payment frames had no effect on farmers9 interest in conservation tillage across our entire sample. Consistent with the third hypothesis, however, a negative framing effect was found for the profit frame on nonadopters who reported no use of no-till in the past two years. These results support the argument regarding the importance of prior beliefs in reactions to frames. They also suggest the possibility of modest financial payments “crowding out” intrinsic motivations for contributions to public goods such as soil conservation. From a policy perspective, these findings also suggest the relative inefficacy of offers of modest conservation payments or profitability frames in promoting no-till farming, especially among nonadopters, and the need to find alternative frames that avoid reinforcing an argument that nonadopters appear to have already considered and rejected.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个新的情境中考察了框架效应（framing effects）：农民关于保护性耕作做法的决策。主要假设包括：(1)将保护性耕作描述为“有利可图”的框架（即关于某一问题或概念的不同论点），比仅提供基本信息的对照框架更能引起农民对该耕作技术的兴趣；(2)讨论为“环境效益”支付的框架，比讨论为“固存碳（C）”以减缓气候变化而支付的框架，更能产生积极态度；(3)框架效应会因受试者的既有信念和经验而有所不同。这些假设通过对全国范围内的行列作物农民开展的基于调查的实验加以检验。与预期相反，利润框架以及两种支付框架对全部样本中农民对保护性耕作的兴趣均无影响。然而，与第三个假设一致的是，利润框架对过去两年未采用免耕的未采用者产生了负面框架效应。这些结果支持了既有信念在对框架作出反应中具有重要性的论点。它们还表明，少量的经济补偿可能会“挤出”人们为土壤保护等公共物品做贡献的内在动机。从政策角度看，这些发现还表明，适度的保护补偿或利润框架在促进免耕方面相对无效，尤其是对未采用者而言，因此有必要寻找替代框架，以避免强化未采用者似乎已经考虑并拒绝过的论点。

abstract: We develop a bioeconomic model to gain insight into the challenges of Payments for Environmental Services (PES) as applied to protect endangered species given wildlife-livestock disease risks and habitat fragmentation. We show how greater connectivity of habitat creates an endogenous trade-off. More connectedness both (i) ups the chance that populations of endangered species will grow more rapidly, while (ii) simultaneously increasing the likelihood diseases will spread more quickly. We examine subsidies for habitat connectedness, livestock vaccination, and reduced movement of infected livestock. We find the cost-effective policy is to first subsidize habitat connectivity rather than vaccinations – this serves to increase habitat contiguousness. Once habitat is sufficiently connected, disease risks increase to a level to make disease-related subsidies worthwhile. Highly connected habitat requires nearly all the government budget be devoted to disease prevention and control. The result of the conservation payments is significantly increased wildlife abundance, increased livestock health and abundance, and increased development opportunities.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个生物经济模型，以深入探讨在野生动物与家畜疾病风险以及栖息地破碎化的背景下，环境服务付费（Payments for Environmental Services，PES）用于保护濒危物种所面临的挑战。我们表明，栖息地连通性的提高会带来内生的权衡：更高的连通性一方面(i)增加了濒危物种种群更快增长的可能性，另一方面(ii)同时也增加了疾病更快传播的可能性。我们考察了针对栖息地连通性、家畜疫苗接种以及减少受感染家畜流动的补贴。我们发现，成本效益最高的政策是首先补贴栖息地连通性而非疫苗接种，这有助于提高栖息地的连片程度。一旦栖息地达到足够的连通性，疾病风险便会上升到使与疾病相关的补贴变得值得的水平。高度连通的栖息地需要几乎将全部政府预算用于疾病防控。保护付费的结果是野生动物数量显著增加，家畜健康与数量提高，并带来更多发展机会。
